referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Southern Painting house-painting network homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a full-width painted-house lifestyle scene with a navy estimate form floating at the upper right. It uses navy utility row with location and phone controls, then a service menu. The visual system relies on firm sans service headings with white-over-photo hero copy; surfaces include white, pale blue, navy and accents include paint red, light blue. Imagery is finished homes, room interiors, paint swatches, and homeowner scenes. The page then runs through painted-house estimate hero, intro and location action, service selection over room image, color-selection education, homeowner review, offer panel, video examples, resource cards, location map and footer. Its service presentation is vertical service menu that changes the featured room image and explanation. Mobile changes to keep the estimate path visible after the opening image, stack service choices, and avoid a tiny swatch or map interface. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Southern Painting marks, exact roller motif, lifestyle photos, reviews, offers, warranties, ratings, or supplier logos.
